response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS mean_unfilled FROM per_order), above_first AS (SELECT p.avg_unfilled, p.avg_unfilled - b.mean_unfilled AS excess_first FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_unfilled > b.mean_unfilled), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS mean_unfilled FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(a.avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled, AVG(a.excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(a.avg_unfilled - b.mean_unfilled) AS avg_excess_second FROM above_first a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE a.avg_unfilled > b.mean_unfilled;
